result.summary: The page is largely intact with no blocking breakage, but there are minor visual inconsistencies in carousel truncation, favorite-button styling, time-badge formatting, and a questionable -100% promo badge.

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' shows restaurant name truncated mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol' at the screen edge with no padding or ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding to the horizontal carousel and use proper text truncation with ellipsis so names do not appear abruptly clipped mid-letter.

issues.description: Favorite heart buttons are inconsistent: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a bare white outline with no background while the pizza card below has a white outline on a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Apply one consistent favorite-button style with a contrasting scrim or circular background to ensure visibility on all images.

issues.description: Delivery time badges use inconsistent spacing: '15-25 min' and '20-30 min' with spaces vs '20-30 min' without spaces.
issues.suggestion: Standardize all time-range labels to a single format with consistent spacing and dash style.

issues.description: Second card in 'Popular right now' shows a '-100%' badge which looks like erroneous or placeholder promo data.
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount value from the backend and replace with a valid promotion or remove the badge if no discount applies.
